title: ApplicationRunFacet
description: A tailored CV and cover letter prepared for one job. Counts and ids only: no CV or letter text, no identity data.

job_content_hash.description: Version of the ad the documents were written for

country_profile.description: Key in config/countries.yml, e.g. nl, de, gb

bullets_dropped_unverified.description: CV bullets the model returned that were not in the CV word for word

ids_rejected.description: Item ids the model chose that do not exist

flags.description: Numbers or skills in generated text not found in the CV

skills_not_in_cv.description: Skills the ad asks for that the CV does not show
